content: Kurubanina Samia Iaiaro Misikini
Wakutuuna Isa atilitiliki manga mia morangkaea tangasaana apapesua doi pasombaana i nuncana sorongana pasombaa,
Incia akamata uka samia iaiaro momisikini, apapesua rua tibha doi tambaga momaidhiidhina mpuu.
Kasiimpo Isa apogau, "Rangoa, kupogau tee ingkomiu, iaiaro momisikini sii apapesua kurubani abhari mpuu minaaka i mosagaanana,

roonamo manga mia morangkaea sumai adhawu pasombaana minaaka i labhina harataana, maka o iaiaro sumai adhawuaka pasombaana minaaka i kakurangana, siitumo bhari-bharia harataa modhaangiana i karona, motofaraluuna to dhadhina saesaeo."
Baitulla Bheatopahancuru
Wakutuuna manga mia apogauaka Baitulla tee amenteakamo manga bhatu makesa tee manga bara pasombaa mosagaanana mobhelokina bhanuana Kawasana Opu sumai, Isa apogau,
"Bhari-bharia ikamatamiu iwe sumai, bheakawa o wakutuuna naile itu bheatopahancuru, tee inda bheadhaangia saangu bhatu uka momboorena motosuncu i bhawona bhatu mosagaanana."
Bhaa-bhaana kanarakaa
Kasiimpo manga murina aabha, "E Guru, naepia o giu incia sumai bheamembali? Opea o tandana ande akawamo wakutuuna giu incia sumai bheamembali?"
Isa apogau, "Pengkanaaka ancosala dhaangia tee mia mopasaladhalakomiu. Roonamo abhari o mia bhemoumbana apake saroku tee apogau, 'Iakumo Incia,' tee, 'Wakutuuna amakasumo.' Bholi uose manga incia.

Ande ingkomiu urango manga lele soʼalina lipu mopotimbe tee manga mia mopewauna karobho, bholi umaeka. Roonamo manga giu incia sumai tabeana amembali porikana, maka o maʼanana mencuana wakutuuna kiaamati amakasumo."
Isa apogau i manga incia, "Saangu lipu bheaewangi lipu mosagaanana tee saangu raja bheaewangi raja mosagaanana.
Sapadhana incia sumai, bheamembali uka apegiu lendu momakaa mpuu, kaara tee wabaa panyaki i bhari tampa, manga giu motomaeka, tee manga tanda inda momentela momaoge i laiana.

Maka indapo giu incia sumai amembali, ingkomiu bheutorako tee utopanarakaa. Ingkomiu bheutopasaraaka i tampana ibaadati to utoʼadili tee uka bheapapesuakomiu i katorongku tee bheabhawakomiu i aroana manga raja tee manga gubernuru rampaakanamo saroku.
Siitumo kalalesamiu to upakawaaka Lele Malape minaaka i Aulataʼala.
Roonamo sumai, patotapua o incamiu, mamudhaakana inda uporikana ufikiri opea ipogauakamiu.
Roonamo o karoku bhemodhawukomiu kapooli to upogau tee hikimati mamudhaakana manga musumiu inda amembali aewangikomiu atawa alawanikomiu.
Manga mancuanamiu, manga witinaimiu, leemiu, walakamiu, tee manga musirahamiu bheapasaraakakomiu tee sampemo dhaangia uka minaaka i tanga-tangamiu bheapekamatea manga incia.
Ingkomiu bheamarikakomiu bhari-bharia mia, rampaakanamo uose Iaku.
Maka moomini satake bulua i bhaamiu inda bheakailanga.
Ande ingkomiu upotaangi tee usabara, ingkomiu bheusalaamati."
Kabinasana Kota Yerusalem
Ande ingkomiu ukamata kota Yerusalem ahumbunia manga tantara, mataumea ande o kabinasana amakasumo.

Wakutuu incia sumai, manga mia modhaangiana i lipu Yudea tabeana apalaiaka karona i gunu. Mia modhaangiana i nuncana kota tabeana alimba minaaka iwe sumai, tee o mia modhaangiana i sambalina kota bholi apesua pendua i nuncana kota.
Roonamo i wakutuu incia sumai o Aulataʼala bheahukumu kota sumai, tee bhari-bharia motoburina i nuncana Kitabi Momangkilo to giu incia sumai bheamembalimo.
Cilakamo o eo incia sumai to bhawine mobhawa-bhawa, tee bhawine mopaduduna anana! Roonamo lipu incia sii bheapotibhaaka kasukara momaoge tee bheapokawaaka amarana Aulataʼala.

Dhaangia motopekamatena tee ewanga, dhaangia uka motobhawana mboomo mia mototaangi i lipuna mia, tee manga lipu inda momatauna Aulataʼala bhealanda-landaki kota Yerusalem sakawana amondo o wakutuu ibhotukiakana Kawasana Opu to manga incia."
Umbaana Anana Maanusia
Ibaratina to Puuna Angguru
I matanaeo, bula, tee manga kalipopo bheatokamata manga tanda. I alamu, manga lipu aposamaekamo aaro-aro ruuna tawo tee ewo.
Manga mia bheamateakamo kaeka roonamo aaro-aromo opea bhemomembalina i saangua alamu sii, roonamo manga antona laiana bheabagoea.
Wakutuu incia sumaimo manga mia bheakamata Anana Maanusia aumba i nuncana taʼina ngalu tee kuasana tee kamuliangina momaoge
Ande manga giu incia sumai apepuumo amembali, ubhangumo tee uangkamea o roumiu, roonamo indamo amangenge ingkomiu bheapabebasikomiumo."
Kasiimpo Isa apetulatulaakamo ibarati sii i manga incia, "Tontoa o puuna ara atawa o puuna kau mosagaanana.
Ande ingkomiu ukamatea manga puuna kau sumai apepuumo atuna, sumaimo umataumea ande o kapanena eo amakasumo.
Mboo sumai uka, ande ingkomiu ukamata manga giu incia sumai amembali, mataumea ande o Pamarintana Aulataʼala amakasumo.
Satototuuna kupogau tee ingkomiu, manga giu incia sumai bheamembali porikana, indapo manga mia modhadhina sii-sii amate bhari-bharia.
Laiana tee alamu bheabinasa, maka o pogauku sadhaadhaa saʼumurua."
Audhaniakea Mamudhaakana Apengkaanaka

"Jagania o karomiu, mamudhaakana incamiu inda laulauna afikiriaka manga kariaa to imalangoaka tee manga giu imeriaka i nuncana dhadhita saesaeo, ande ingkomiu sadia upewau mboo sumai, sumaimo ingkomiu bheusiapu utarima umbaana Anana Maanusia. Tee o giu incia sumai bheapatokidhakomiu tee apabinasakomiu mboomo katapu.
Roonamo o eo incia sumai bheakangkanai bhari-bharia mia i alamu sii.
Kojakojagamo tee udoʼamo sadia mamudhaakana amembali usalaamati minaaka i bhari-bharia bhemomembalina sumai, tee amembali ukakaro i aroana Anana Maanusia."
Saesaeo o Isa aadhari i Baitulla, sainamo o malo Incia alingka i Gunu Zaitun tee amboore iwe sumai.
Malo-malo bhari-bharia mia aumba i Incia i Baitulla to arangoaka kaadharina.
